title: Sound and Communication Systems Installer Apprenticeship
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

program.section_heading: Sound and Communication Systems Installer Apprenticeship - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - NAS644/C/NCE644
outcomes: Analysis a circuit of electrical device(s) with the appropriate meters or testing equipment so that troubleshooting of common system faults can be detected and repair.
Demonstrate electrical wiring of circuits or devices to meet the standards and requirement of the NEC.

notes: The page prints one section and one requirements list shared by the A.S. degree and the Certificate of Achievement; the certificate is read from that shared list.
The Program Learning Outcomes are printed once for the program as a whole (degree and certificate); the certificate shares them.

The introduction calls this a '37 unit' certificate and AS degree, but the requirements state 'Units: 22.00- 25.00' and 'Total : 22.00- 25.00'; the stated requirements total was recorded. The award level (30 to fewer than 60 units) also does not match the 22-25 unit total; reviewer should check.
Codes are printed with hyphens (e.g., ELE-423); they correspond to the closed-list codes (ELE 423 etc.), so none are marked as catalog additions.
ELE-499 is printed with a variable range of 1.00-4.00 units, while the closed list stores 1 unit.
